propositions: Eight CI pytest lanes lacked per-test hang guards, allowing deadlocked tests to hide behind final dots with no traceback or culprit identification
Per-test timeout budgets were calibrated per-lane from historical GitHub Actions runtime data, ranging 300s–3600s based on 10x observed mean per-test duration

A new exhaustive workflow parity assertion detects pytest invocations across all forms (pytest, python -m pytest, path-prefixed variants) and requires both --timeout and --timeout-method=thread flags on every pytest-invoking step
External-integration.yml lanes targeting live LLM and Jira services received 900s budgets to accommodate legitimate variance; offline unit test lanes received 300s
The _optionality.yml degradation-path step's minimal venv required an explicit pytest-timeout dependency addition to honor the new timeout flags
